2.t: There is no denying that it will befall -

4.t: When the earth is shaken with a shock

5.t: And the hills are ground to powder

6.t: So that they become a scattered dust,

7.t: And ye will be three kinds:

8.t: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

9.t: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?

10.t: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:

11.t: Those are they who will be brought nigh

13.t: A multitude of those of old

14.t: And a few of those of later time.

17.t: There wait on them immortal youths

18.t: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring

19.t: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,

21.t: And flesh of fowls that they desire.

22.t: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,

24.t: Reward for what they used to do.

25.t: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination

26.t: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.

27.t: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

33.t: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,

35.t: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation

38.t: For those on the right hand;

39.t: A multitude of those of old

40.t: And a multitude of those of later time.

41.t: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?

42.t: In scorching wind and scalding water

45.t: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury

46.t: And used to persist in the awful sin.

47.t: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,

49.t: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time

50.t: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.

51.t: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,

52.t: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum

53.t: And will fill your bellies therewith;

54.t: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,

55.t: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.

56.t: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.

57.t: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?

58.t: Have ye seen that which ye emit?

59.t: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?

60.t: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,

61.t: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.

62.t: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?

63.t: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?

64.t: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?

65.t: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:

66.t: Lo! we are laden with debt!

68.t: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?

69.t: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?

70.t: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?

71.t: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;

72.t: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?

73.t: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.

74.t: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.

75.t: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -

76.t: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -

77.t: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an

79.t: Which none toucheth save the purified,

80.t: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

81.t: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,

82.t: And make denial thereof your livelihood?

83.t: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)

84.t: And ye are at that moment looking

85.t: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -

86.t: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),

87.t: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?

88.t: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,

89.t: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.

90.t: And if he is of those on the right hand,

91.t: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.

92.t: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,

93.t: Then the welcome will be boiling water

96.t: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
